description: Test suite for TalkMode configuration parsing in the OpenClaw project, verifying payload validation, fallback logic, and default handling for silence timeout.

classes.name: TalkModeConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test cases for validating TalkMode configuration parsing logic.

methods.name: `rejects normalized talk provider payload without resolved`
methods.description: Tests that a talk provider payload missing the 'resolved' field is rejected (returns nil).

methods.name: `falls back to legacy talk fields when normalized payload missing`
methods.description: Verifies fallback to legacy fields when normalized payload is absent.

methods.name: `reads configured silence timeout ms`
methods.description: Checks that the silence timeout value is read correctly from configuration.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when missing`
methods.description: Ensures the default silence timeout is used when none is provided.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when invalid`
methods.description: Checks fallback to default when silence timeout value is invalid (e.g., zero).
